name: 考据
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new standalone card illustration for a scholarly memory roguelike. Input reference is STYLE ONLY: match its bold black ink woodcut, strong cut-paper silhouette, carved ivory hatching, warm bone-white opaque paper and tiny restrained accent. Do not copy the closed notebook and quill composition. Square canvas, no border, no UI, no lettering, no readable writing, no numerals. A single clear central visual with rich engraved detail, not sparse minimalist clipart, readable at 96px. Keep whole subject inside central 85%, plain bone-white background, no scenery. Subject: scholarly examination of evidence. A large circular magnifying glass tilted diagonally across two overlapping antique manuscript fragments, revealing a crisp engraved branching diagram under the lens. Paper edges, wax seal and small bookmark give depth. Abstract scratches only, no text. Magnifying glass dominates the silhouette; tiny muted brick-red seal. No eye or skull.
